fusions.name: Both Ways
fusions.desc: Throws the fork, dealing 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then it leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 100% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Splayed Tines
fusions.desc: Splays both tines in a wide arc, dealing 14 damage to everything within 4 tiles in front of you and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Other Branch
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Prong Reply
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a prong flies to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 6 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 8 seconds.
